case_studies.selection_rule: earliest two per fixed category; old-trend extension means >=1 ATR in next 8 M15 bars

decision.reason: No candidate passed all four hard gates plus in-leg timely and wrong-exposure requirements; no third variant is allowed on this window.

limitations: The 180-day window has already been used for research and is not independent validation.
Facts-only entry candidates have no positions, fills, fees, portfolio limits, or broker context.
Same-roll-date closing differences create lookahead risk for earlier roll-day bars.
Unverified fees prohibit net performance evaluation.

roll_lookahead_sensitivity.lookahead_risk: same-roll-date closing difference is applied to earlier bars on the roll date
